items.description: Confirm the current branch and announce it before release work begins.
Confirm the working tree is clean or that unrelated changes are intentionally excluded.
Record whether this is a stable release or an explicitly approved prerelease.
Approve the product release label and exact AVR and ESP embedded version pair.
Confirm the release supports only FlexFox Ver 2.1 (Mar 2022).
Freeze and record the exact clean source commit used for both release builds.
Run the full repository check at the frozen source commit.
Build AVR Release firmware twice with pinned tools and record matching hashes, warnings, resources, and EEPROM ABI.
Build the ESP sketch twice with the qualified profile and record matching sketch hashes, warnings, and resources.
Generate the release manifest, checksums, package README, and exact AVR, ESP, and LittleFS artifact set.
Independently validate manifest fields, package contents, file sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.
Complete the versioned FlexFox hardware checklist, recording every approved skip explicitly.
Install the selected pair on a representative unit and capture the expected combined AVR and ESP version report.
Select and verify the release rollback package and recovery instructions.
Approve concise maintainer notes that separate changes, verification, compatibility, and deferrals.
Obtain explicit approval to integrate the candidate into main.
Verify the clean integrated main commit and reproduce the selected release artifacts from it.
Obtain explicit approval for the maintenance release, tag, and designated durable archive.
Create and push an annotated release tag pointing to the verified release commit.
Create a durable maintainer release record with the approved notes and verification summary.
Store the validated release ZIP and individually required firmware assets in the designated durable archive.
Copy and independently verify the archived assets, hashes, release record, and tag target.
